value: The CfCbazar AI system is a pure PHP modular assistant that runs on shared hosting without Composer installs.
content: The CfCbazar AI system is a pure PHP modular assistant that runs on shared hosting without Composer installs.

value: The main pipeline is Router then PromptUnderstandingSkill then KnowledgeSkill then ResponseUnderstandingSkill.
content: The main pipeline is Router then PromptUnderstandingSkill then KnowledgeSkill then ResponseUnderstandingSkill.

value: PromptUnderstandingSkill analyzes the user prompt and extracts intent topic entities question type and a query embedding.
content: PromptUnderstandingSkill analyzes the user prompt and extracts intent topic entities question type and a query embedding.

value: KnowledgeSkill retrieves local memory first and only calls OpenRouter for new knowledge when enabled and memory is insufficient.
content: KnowledgeSkill retrieves local memory first and only calls OpenRouter for new knowledge when enabled and memory is insufficient.

value: ResponseUnderstandingSkill cleans and formats the final answer without calling OpenRouter or writing memory.
content: ResponseUnderstandingSkill cleans and formats the final answer without calling OpenRouter or writing memory.

value: FactSkill extracts factual statements from text and attaches local embeddings to each fact.
content: FactSkill extracts factual statements from text and attaches local embeddings to each fact.

value: LocalEmbedder creates fixed length embedding vectors in pure PHP using feature hashing n-grams and L2 normalization.
content: LocalEmbedder creates fixed length embedding vectors in pure PHP using feature hashing n-grams and L2 normalization.

value: Local embeddings use 1536 dimensions so they match the former OpenRouter embedding size without using the API for vectors.
content: Local embeddings use 1536 dimensions so they match the former OpenRouter embedding size without using the API for vectors.

value: MemoryStore saves facts under memory topics JSON files and maintains an index in memory memory.json.
content: MemoryStore saves facts under memory topics JSON files and maintains an index in memory memory.json.

value: Each topic file holds discrete facts with content confidence source timestamps and an embedding array.
content: Each topic file holds discrete facts with content confidence source timestamps and an embedding array.

value: Vector search ranks facts with cosine similarity implemented in pure PHP.
content: Vector search ranks facts with cosine similarity implemented in pure PHP.

value: Keyword search is used as a fallback when vector matches are weak or missing.
content: Keyword search is used as a fallback when vector matches are weak or missing.

value: OpenRouter is used only as an optional chat knowledge source when config features openrouter_enabled is true.
content: OpenRouter is used only as an optional chat knowledge source when config features openrouter_enabled is true.

value: When openrouter_enabled is false the system answers from local memory and conversation context only.
content: When openrouter_enabled is false the system answers from local memory and conversation context only.

value: config features.php controls openrouter_enabled conversation_enabled and conversation_max_turns.
content: config features.php controls openrouter_enabled conversation_enabled and conversation_max_turns.

value: Conversation memory is stored in memory conversation session.json with up to ten recent turns.
content: Conversation memory is stored in memory conversation session.json with up to ten recent turns.

value: When conversation capacity is full the system drops the outlier turn least similar to the cluster of other turns plus the new turn.
content: When conversation capacity is full the system drops the outlier turn least similar to the cluster of other turns plus the new turn.

value: SpellCorrector applies conservative single edit corrections and avoids false fixes like food to good or trust to true.
content: SpellCorrector applies conservative single edit corrections and avoids false fixes like food to good or trust to true.

value: Fuzzy topic resolution maps misspelled topic slugs such as vecrot embedings toward vector embeddings when possible.
content: Fuzzy topic resolution maps misspelled topic slugs such as vecrot embedings toward vector embeddings when possible.

value: seed.php writes facts with local embeddings into MemoryStore without calling OpenRouter.
content: seed.php writes facts with local embeddings into MemoryStore without calling OpenRouter.

value: consolidate.php merges similar topics and can backfill missing embeddings on existing facts.
content: consolidate.php merges similar topics and can backfill missing embeddings on existing facts.

value: KnowledgeSkill filters out prompt intent records meta refusals and near copies of the user question.
content: KnowledgeSkill filters out prompt intent records meta refusals and near copies of the user question.

value: KnowledgeSkill ranks facts with a hybrid score combining vector similarity keyword overlap and key phrase boosts.
content: KnowledgeSkill ranks facts with a hybrid score combining vector similarity keyword overlap and key phrase boosts.

value: Complex prompts can set constraints such as simple step by step brief detailed and with examples.
content: Complex prompts can set constraints such as simple step by step brief detailed and with examples.

value: Multi part prompts can produce structured answers with separate parts when enough facts are available.
content: Multi part prompts can produce structured answers with separate parts when enough facts are available.
